description: This file defines an immutable implementation of a JSON object, including methods for setting, getting, removing fields, and handling nested JSON structures. It also includes internal classes for managing field maps with caching and serialization support.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObject
classes.description: An immutable implementation of a JSON object with methods for manipulation and retrieval of JSON fields.

classes.name: SoftReferencedFieldMap
classes.description: A cache-efficient, soft-reference-based map for JSON fields supporting lazy parsing and serialization.

classes.name: FieldMapJsonHandler
classes.description: A thread-unsafe JSON handler for parsing JSON strings into a Map of JsonFields.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of an empty JSON object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableJsonObject from a map of fields, with optional string or CBOR representations.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value for a given key, returning a new JSON object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JsonField or a field based on a definition, returning a new JSON object.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Adds multiple fields to the JSON object, returning a new instance.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key or nested path exists within the JSON object.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key or path as an Optional.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a nested JSON object based on a pointer or field definition.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a field by key or pointer, returning a new JSON object.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns a list of all keys in the JSON object.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves a specific field by key, supporting nested paths.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Indicates this is a JSON object.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns this object as a JSON object.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the JSON fields.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the JSON object has no fields.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the JSON object using the provided context.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Estimates the maximum string size when serialized.
